name: KY-008
title: 650 nm 5 mW red laser diode module, digital on/off, 3–5 V
titleRu: Лазерный модуль 650 нм 5 мВт, цифровое включение, 3–5 В

pins.name: S
pins.desc: Signal: HIGH turns the laser on

pins.name: VCC
pins.desc: Unlabelled middle pin, +5V per most sources

notes: Pins from the silkscreen: S (signal), unlabelled middle, - (GND). Most sources call the middle pin +5V; some say it is unused (it reaches the diode via a resistor), so S and - alone may also work.
Draws about 30–40 mA, within an Arduino pin limit; on 3.3 V the beam is dimmer than at 5 V.
Never look into the beam or point it at eyes.
Do not leave the laser on constantly for long; the diode heats up.
